Offline annotation aid. Draw the crater floor and inner rim boundary on the left XY height map. Do not trace shadows or the outer ejecta field. Terrain05 has several depressions: add one polygon for each crater you accept. These proposals need human review and are not labels until you save and review them.

Click at least three boundary points, then Finish.
